prompts.slate:
Use case: style-transfer. ONE transparent underwater platform sprite for Councillion.
Reference 1 is the ORIGINAL ROCK SPRITE. Reference 2 is the ORIGINAL COUNSEL CHARACTER. Match their clean low-resolution pixel style and restrained level of detail EXACTLY: around 80x40 logical pixels, visible even-sized square pixel steps, about 8 colors, three broad flat shading levels, simple dark outlines, a few small accents. The result should look like another small sprite by the same artist. Do not use detailed painted texture, noise, fine dithering, gradients, realistic rendering, 3D lighting, busy decorations or tiny grain.
This is a DIFFERENT KIND OF PLATFORM, not another rock. Keep the original rock's low broad horizontal proportions, shallow 3/4 view, flattened central standing surface and small contact shadow. Everything is resting on the seabed. One isolated object, complete silhouette visible, no background scene or extra props. Genuine transparent alpha with ample padding. No labels, lettering, UI, badges, glow or sparkles. Muted underwater tones harmonizing with the reference, dark navy shadow edges. Scale all marks like the original sprites.
SPECIFIC PLATFORM: DRIFTWOOD PERCH: one short thick water-worn driftwood log lying horizontally, a gently flattened broad top, one visible irregular cut end and just two simple large grain lines, small chipped end. Muted desaturated brown/grey wood, dark navy-blue shadows, pale restrained tan highlights. A single grounded log, not a raft, not rocks, no big plants.
